summary: TriLinc Global Impact Fund, LLC filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) disclosing a monthly portfolio update as of August 31, 2026. Portfolio assets, including fair-valued borrower investments, were approximately $283 million, with weighted average loan size near $10 million and weighted average duration of 0.4 years. Cumulative funded investments total roughly $1.210 billion across 103 borrower companies, including $104.7 million in temporary investments, supporting 43,572 permanent employees, with about $916.0 million, or 76%, repaid. No transaction, terms, advisor, or board recommendation is stated; the report contains no special-situation event to monitor.
